jobs.title: Principal HRBP, Amazon Stores India, Amazon Stores PXT
jobs.description:
This role anchors PXT support for a set of Corporate Operations teams in India under Udit Madan — one of the most strategically dense Principal HRBP charters in Amazon India. Three businesses, each large enough to demand its own people strategy, each navigating a different kind of change at once: ASCS is in business transformation, SCOT is in team-and-org evolution, and the broader Corp Ops portfolio is consolidating its PXT support model alongside a multi-year, GenAI-led workforce transformation. The incumbent partners directly with multiple L8 leaders (tech and non-tech), sets the HR strategy for the combined client group, and operates with the autonomy and influence of a Principal — shaping org design, talent, culture, and workforce transformation rather than executing someone else’s plan. The connective tissue is the common disciplines — org design, span-of-control, leadership depth, talent movement, change leadership — applied to three distinct problems.

Key job responsibilities
• Org design & planning: set HR strategy and goals for the client group; lead org design, succession, and change leadership across all three businesses within OP1/OP2/R&O/S-Team goals..
• Talent management: drive forward-looking promotions, succession and top-talent movement incl. L7→L8; coach senior business and tech leaders; partner with Comp/Benefits/Stock in a high-mobility market.
• Workforce planning: partner with Finance & Recruiting on OP1/OP2/R&O headcount; set sourcing strategy and strengthen the senior tech/science pipeline.
• Data & culture: use Clarity to diagnose and influence; role-model Leadership Principles and preserve Day-1 culture through scale.
• Function as a coach and consultant to key leaders and their respective organizations; engage in strategic planning meetings to translate business needs into HR plans.
• Review and analyze business metrics including data on retention and employee experience to recommend systemic improvements

Core Responsibilities
Recruit passive candidates with the mentality to "profile people and gauge chemistry of candidates for fit and understand their motivation" rather than sell a role

jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s People team supports a complex, rapidly growing organization of researchers, engineers, and business teams. The Compensation function ensures accuracy, scalability, and operational excellence across all compensation tools, systems, and data flows.



About the Role

We’re hiring a Compensation Operations Analyst to build and run the systems, tools, and processes that power compensation at OpenAI. This role is deeply operational and technical: you will configure HRIS modules, manage compensation tools end-to-end, maintain pristine data quality, and ensure compensation cycles run flawlessly. You’ll partner closely with People Systems, Total Rewards, Finance, and vendors to keep our compensation infrastructure accurate, scalable, and audit-ready.



This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.



In this role, you will:

 - Own configuration and day-to-day operations of compensation tools and HRIS compensation modules.

 - Manage annual and off-cycle compensation processes, ensuring data integrity, testing, quality assurance, and on-time execution.

 - Build and maintain compensation datasets, dashboards, audits, and data flows across systems.

 - Lead compensation vendor relationships, including implementation, troubleshooting, and data submissions.

 - Diagnose and resolve system issues, identify root causes, and drive process and tooling improvements.

 - Partner with People Systems and Engineering to enhance architecture, workflows, and automation.

 - Ensure high data accuracy across compensation systems and proactively identify gaps, risks, or anomalies.

 - Translate technical or complex compensation system issues into clear guidance for stakeholders.



You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 5+ years of experience in compensation operations, HR operations/systems, or total rewards tooling in high-growth or technology environ

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
About this Team

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) team at OpenAI partners with leaders to navigate complex organizational and talent decisions where the right path is not always obvious. We are building a higher-leverage HRBP model: staying close enough to the business to understand its realities, while focusing our time on the work that requires judgment, influence, context, and leadership partnership.

This role is for an HRBP who can diagnose ambiguous situations, translate business strategy into organizational and talent decisions, coach leaders through consequential choices, and help build the operating rhythms that enable scale. While the role spans both strategic and operational work, the bar is not to be helpful on everything. The bar is to improve decision quality, strengthen leadership capability, and increase organizational effectiveness.

We operate with urgency, empathy, and sound judgment. We value sincerity, intellectual honesty, and collaboration over ego, and focus relentlessly on creating meaningful impact.



About this Role

This role is part of a shared hiring pathway for HRBPs at OpenAI. Instead of hiring directly for a single team, we evaluate candidates holistically first, then identify the best fit across our organization as you advance. This approach ensures alignment between your skills, interests, and where our needs are greatest—whether that’s partnering with technical leaders in engineering, supporting product teams driving user impact, or enabling operational excellence across business functions.

As a Senior HR Business Partner, you’ll be a trusted advisor to leaders and their teams. You’ll help set direction for how we organize, grow, and lead—stepping in as both a sounding board and a problem-solver. This role mixes strategic advising with hands-on support: you’ll design better systems, coach managers through complex situations, and help us make trade-offs that keep our people and mission in balance. This is an individual contributor

We are looking for candidates with who possess communication and interpersonal skills that let them communicate with ease, across levels from shop floor employees to senior leaders. About the Team

OpenAI’s Recruiting team helps bring together the people who advance our mission of ensuring artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. We partner closely with leaders across the company to identify exceptional talent, build thoughtful hiring processes, and deliver an outstanding candidate experience.

This role supports Applied Foundations, partnering with engineering leaders to hire the managers and senior leaders who will help build and scale OpenAI’s foundational engineering capabilities.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced technical recruiter with a strong track record of hiring engineering leaders. You’ll own leadership searches from initial role definition and talent mapping through assessment, offer negotiation, and close.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior engineering leaders, helping clarify what each role requires, understand the talent market, and make thoughtful hiring decisions. You’ll bring the judgment to navigate ambiguous searches, the credibility to engage accomplished engineering leaders, and the persistence to build relationships well before someone is ready to make a move.

Experience in executive search or an in-house leadership recruiting function is particularly valuable. You should be equally comfortable shaping a search strategy and personally doing the work to deliver a successful hire.

In this role, you will:

 - Lead full-cycle searches for senior engineering leaders across Applied Foundations.

 - Partner with hiring leaders to define role scope, leadership expectations, technical requirements, and the outcomes a successful hire will deliver.

 - Develop talent maps and targeted search strategies, combining direct sourcing, referrals, market research, and long-term relationship building.

 - Engage passive leadership candidates through thoughtful outreach and substantive conversations about their experience, motivations, and potential impact at OpenAI.

 - Partner with hiring team

About the Team

At OpenAI, we are dedicated to building safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) to benefit all of humanity. Our mission attracts the world’s top talent across research, engineering, product, policy, and operations. OpenAI’s Recruiting Operations (RecOps) team provides the systems, workflows, and data foundation that power hiring at OpenAI. Within RecOps, the Systems & Enablement function owns the recruiting technology ecosystem—ensuring our ATS, offer workflows, and connected tools are reliable, well-governed, and user-centric.

About the Role

We are seeking a Systems & Enablement Lead, Recruiting Operations to lead improvements across recruiting processes, systems, and enablement. You’ll identify recurring friction, define the underlying problem, and carry solutions from an initial test through implementation, adoption, and a repeatable operating process.

You’ll partner with Recruiting leaders, People Systems, and hiring teams to translate hiring priorities into scalable processes and programs. You’ll align stakeholders on the most consequential problems, establish shared operating standards, and lead changes that improve recruiting effectiveness. Success means measurable improvements, sustained adoption, and clear ownership that enables teams to operate independently and adapt as hiring needs evolve.

In this role, you will:

 - Lead projects from discovery through adoption, managing scope, milestones, dependencies, and risks.

 - Owning enablement for operational workflow changes, including documentation, training, office hours, and change communication.

 - Supporting offer approval and other sensitive recruiting workflows through clear coordination, followthrough, and exception handling.

 - Identifying recurring support themes and driving fixes through process changes, documentation improvements, automation, or handoff to People Systems.

 - Partnering closely with recruiters, coordinators, People Systems, and cross functional stakeholders

You will build partnerships with local community colleges, technical schools, universities, and union apprenticeship programs from the ground up. Working with educators and technical experts, you will develop and expand training programs that connect local residents with career opportunities and meet the local industry hiring needs.

jobs.title: People Research Scientist
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s People team hires, engages, and retains world-class talent to safely build and deploy AGI that benefits all of humanity. The People Analytics team helps leaders make better, evidence-based talent decisions.

About the Role

As a People Research Scientist, you will bring deep expertise in research design, measurement, experimentation, and applied data science to OpenAI’s most important People programs. You will design studies, evaluate people processes, and help leaders better empower employees, strengthen organizational systems, and deliver exceptional employee experiences.

This is a high-ownership individual contributor role combining hands-on research, methodological leadership, and scalable people science capabilities. We’re looking for an experienced researcher who can turn ambiguous People questions into rigorous designs, validated insights, and actionable recommendations.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA or Mountain View, CA, with occasional travel to our San Francisco office.

What You’ll Do:

 - Design rigorous research and evaluation strategies for recruiting, organizational health, manager effectiveness, employee experience, and talent outcomes.

 - Apply advanced statistical modeling, machine learning, and research methods to inform program design, evaluate effectiveness, and quantify business impact.

 - Partner with People Operations, data engineering, and people systems teams to define data requirements, improve data quality, establish documentation standards, and ensure research datasets are governed, reproducible, and privacy-preserving.

 - Build scalable people science infrastructure, including self-service agentic tools, automated validation workflows, reusable research datasets and analytical pipelines.

 - Develop research playbooks that establish rigorous standards for study design, measurement, validation, and documentation, enabling high-quality, repeatable, and scalable research across the organization.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Learning
jobs.description:
About the Team

The ChatGPT product team is a rapidly evolving, high-impact group within OpenAI that builds intuitive, safe, and useful AI-powered experiences for millions of people worldwide. Our team brings together engineering, design, research, and product to explore how conversational AI can help people learn, create, and solve problems.

AI has the potential to transform how millions of people learn, teach, and achieve their goals. Learning is one of the top use cases on ChatGPT— not only for students, but also for adults building new skills in a rapidly changing world. The Education team is focused on advancing how humans learn with AI and working to make high-quality learning accessible. We aim to deliver measurable gains in cognition and achievement, partnering closely with students, educators, and country leaders to ensure new tools are safe, effective, and trusted.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Education & Learning, you will shape the strategy and build products to advance learning experiences in ChatGPT— defining a category that could reshape classrooms, careers, and lifelong learning. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional partners—from AI research to design to go-to-market—to build ChatGPT into a true learning agent and ensure those products you build meet the needs of stakeholders throughout the ecosystem. You will also partner closely with product teams across growth, youth well-being, and enterprise to ensure alignment and maximize impact.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Define and drive the product vision for education and learning in ChatGPT.

 - Partner with research teams to explore how AI can better advance learning outcomes

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including design, engineering, product, and go-to-market—to bring education features to life.

 - Partner with xfn
